color.note: Interpreted from soco-st.com's described style (simple, cute, line-drawn, color-changeable). Values are an interpretation, not extracted CSS.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and card surfaces. Most of every screen is this white.

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: Warm cream band behind alternating sections (Popular 热门 / New 最新) and the footer.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Tag chip fill, thumbnail well behind illustrations, search field fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, dividers. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons); 3.2:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings (12.3:1 on paper); also the single line colour of illustrations.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, dates, captions. 4.9:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on paper-sunk.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signature warm yellow. Fill for primary buttons, active nav underline, highlight blobs. Text on it is always ink (7.8:1) — never white.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for brand buttons; ink on it 5.8:1.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Soft yellow highlight: selected tag, notice banners, '可自由换色！' callouts.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links and focus rings (5.2:1 on paper).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element.

tokens.name: fav
tokens.usage: Favourite heart icon (4.1:1, icon use). Not for body text.

tokens.name: fill-skin
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — skin. Decorative only, never behind text smaller than 24px without ink.

tokens.name: fill-sky
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — clothing/sky; also category-tile background.

tokens.name: fill-mint
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — plants/clothing; category-tile background.

tokens.name: fill-pink
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — cheeks/clothing; category-tile background.

tokens.name: fill-lilac
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — clothing/goods; also the third series colour (e.g. rule C) beside fill-sky and fill-mint: similar lightness, distinct hue, ink on it 8.4:1. Added so a third series never borrows brand-soft, which reads as emphasis.

tokens.name: fill-yellow
tokens.usage: Illustration fill — light yellow areas; category-tile background.

families.sans: "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
